Auto-discovery — experimental

Devices that share a space name find each other on their own, with no codes. This is the only part of Beam that touches anything outside your devices: a free public broker run by the PeerJS project passes the two connection blobs. Files and text still go straight between devices and never reach it. It can be slow, rate-limited or down, and Beam falls back to codes when it is.

Passphrase

Camera and sound beams travel in the open — anyone pointing a camera at your screen can read them. Set a passphrase here and both devices need the same one. Leave it empty for none. Wi-Fi links are always encrypted regardless.
